observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black and white multifunction copier wrapped tightly in clear plastic/cellophane, apparently for shipping or storage.
Brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' logo and model text 'bizhub 283' are clearly visible on the front panel in photo 0 and photo 1.
A white control panel with numeric keypad and two colored buttons (teal 'Avvio/start' and red) is visible in photo 0, but the screen is not illuminated, no sign the unit is powered on.
Multiple paper trays are visible, numbered 1, 3, 4 (drawer fronts) in photo 0 and 1.
Photo 2 is a close-up of the side/front showing a dirty, scuffed white plastic panel with visible grime and scratches, and a control area with a small screen and colored buttons.
The unit sits on bare, dirty, uneven ground/pavement outdoors in all three photos, not in a showroom or office.
A watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appear across all photos, consistent with a resale listing, not proof of origin.
No photo shows the unit powered on, a test print, toner/drum compartment open, page counter, or rear/power cable.

claims.evidence: No import sticker, shipping label, or documentation shown in any photo to confirm origin or prior usage location.

claims.claim: very strong zero problematic (implying fully functional, no faults)
claims.evidence: No photo or video shows the unit powered on, printing, scanning, or displaying a status screen; condition of internals (drum, toner, rollers) not shown.

claims.claim: prints up to 28 pages per [minute] (standard bizhub 283 spec)
claims.evidence: This is a generic manufacturer spec for this model, not something shown or demonstrated for this specific unit.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have internal faults (drum, fuser, feed rollers) common in used copiers.
risks.proof: Video of the machine powered on, control panel lit, and a live test print/copy coming out of the tray.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Heavy prior usage (high page count) not disclosed, which affects drum/toner life and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of the internal page counter or maintenance/service menu screen showing total page count.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage/unknown usage, discounted accordingly

risks.risk: Cosmetic and structural wear visible on white panel (photo 2) may indicate rough handling or age beyond 'Germany use, very strong' claim.
risks.proof: Clear, well-lit photos of all panels and drawers without plastic wrap, including the top scanner lid.
risks.if_unproven: priced reflecting visible cosmetic wear only, no premium for 'like new' claim

risks.risk: Outdoor storage on dirty/wet ground risks moisture damage to electronics and paper paths.
risks.proof: Photo/video showing dry storage location or confirmation of indoor storage history.
risks.if_unproven: priced with deduction for possible moisture/dust exposure

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, toner cartridges, trays) not shown, which affects out-of-box usability.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories and cables laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit only, accessories not included

proof_requests: Video of the copier powered on with a live test print or copy coming out.
Photo of the internal page/meter counter screen showing total pages printed.
Unwrapped, well-lit photos of all sides and open paper trays/toner compartment.
Photo of power cable and any included accessories.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and model from the photos, but no evidence shows it powering on or functioning, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-verified, possibly faulty used unit with unknown usage history.
